verdict.rationale: Running untrusted code in sandboxes is a fair question for an edge and serverless compute platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack shows no hardware-isolated, disposable sandbox capability. Serverless functions and deploy previews are adjacent features: neither is documented as hardware isolation or ephemeral sandboxing for untrusted code.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run untrusted code in hardware-isolated, disposable sandboxes
